title: AI in urology and andrology clinical-readiness evidence map
description:
Versioned data and code release for the PubMed-indexed clinical-readiness evidence map of artificial intelligence in urology and andrology.

This release contains the final 2,892-record analytic corpus, the complete 1,270-record eligibility-verification table with triggering rule identifiers, evidence levels and record-specific rationales, 38 in-corpus readiness anchors, eight separately labelled extracorpus contextual exemplars, five source-data tables, and deterministic code for rebuilding all five figures.
